name: The New Frontier
summary: The Cenarion Circle calls for explorers to venture into Kalimdor’s frontiers. You are sent to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise.

sections.title: A Call to Explore
sections.body: On Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise, you are directed to Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem. The Cenarion Circle has called for explorers to venture into Kalimdor’s frontiers, and Hamuul is the one to speak with about that call.

faq.answer: Speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise.

faq.q: What is the Cenarion Circle calling for?
faq.answer: The Cenarion Circle calls for explorers to explore Kalimdor’s frontiers.
Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem is on the Elder Rise of Thunder Bluff.

angles.text: As a tauren, you can speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise about the Cenarion Circle’s call to explore Kalimdor’s frontiers.
As a druid, you can speak with Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem on Thunder Bluff’s Elder Rise about the Cenarion Circle’s call to explore Kalimdor’s frontiers.
